20	# Flat base change for the pushforward of a quasi-coherent sheaf (`i = 0`)
21	
22	This file establishes the `i = 0` (direct-image) case of flat base change: the
23	formation of the pushforward `f_* F` of a quasi-coherent sheaf commutes with flat
24	base change on the target.
25	
26	Throughout we work with a (commutative, eventually cartesian) square of schemes
27	```
28	  X' --g'--> X
29	  |f'        |f
30	  v          v
31	  S' --g---> S
32	```
33	recorded by morphisms `f : X ⟶ S`, `g : S' ⟶ S`, `f' : X' ⟶ S'`, `g' : X' ⟶ X`

45	  quasi-compact quasi-separated, the base-change map is an isomorphism.
46
